flushSync.description:
`import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';`

Force React to flush pending updates synchronously, so the DOM is updated by the time the call returns. Uncommon, and can hurt performance — mainly for third-party integrations such as `onbeforeprint`.

强制 React 同步刷新更新，调用返回时 DOM 已更新。此 API 不常用且可能损害性能，主要用于 `onbeforeprint` 等第三方集成场景。
